overview: Theory 1A Gersho-Laguerre Pullback Prior (t1_prior) resolves the continuous-generator / discontinuous-support obstruction in GANs via a clock-free O(B*K*D) Division of Labor on top of the EMPF critic and DualNorm backbone. A checkpointed streaming Zador-Gersho quantizer (C_k, w_k, sigma_{cell,k}^2) decomposes target covariance into macroscopic centroid covariance plus local within-cell covariance; Part A trains a smooth low-energy generator chart G_theta (with prior.z detached) via mass-weighted Sinkhorn barycentric projection and local Gersho pullback kernel isometry, while Part B condenses sampled prior rows into exact mass-balanced Kantorovich-Laguerre islands inside an expanded isometric cloud envelope.
symbols: $G_\theta$ is the generator, $D$ the EMPF critic, $P$ the task prior with $M$ locations $\mu_i \in \mathbb R^{d_z}$ and kernel width $\sigma_z \ge 0$, $(C_k, w_k, \sigma_{\mathrm{cell},k}^2)_{k=1}^K$ is the online Zador-Gersho quantizer of size $K=\min(K_{\max}, B)$, $\psi_k \in \mathbb R$ are persistent zero-mean Kantorovich-Laguerre dual potentials, and $(m_i, v_i, n_i)$ are per-row coherent drift moments.
pseudocode: Initialize G, D and task-owned prior P; bind EMPF critic penalty and T1PullbackPriorRegularizer.
Execute the EMPF critic step on real batch x and generated batch G(z_d).

Sample (z_g, idx) from P; in GANTrainer, update Zador-Gersho quantizer (C_k, w_k, sigma_{cell,k}^2) on real_g with uncovered-mode teleportation and mass-conserving w_k^{d/(d+2)} sigma_{cell,k}^2 distortion splitting.

Part A (mu detached): compute mass-weighted Sinkhorn target y_ot against (C_k, w_k), local Gersho pullback kernel loss matching ||G(mu + sigma_z eps) - G(mu)|| to sigma_{cell,k}, and residual-cooled DualNorm step on G_theta.

Part B (G_theta frozen): assign sampled prior rows u_rows to Laguerre cells k*(i) = argmin_k (||G(mu_i) - C_k||^2 - psi_k), ascend Kantorovich potentials psi_k on w_k - w_fake_ema, and step mu_u along coherent drift SNR m_i / sqrt(v_i).

training_details.loss: Selectable adversarial loss (non-saturating logistic in t1_prior) paired with Part A smooth Sinkhorn chart projection + Gersho pullback isometry in GANTrainer, and EMPF Sinkhorn/fiber loss on component hosts.
training_details.optimizer: Zero-momentum DualNorm (newton_schulz_hybrid_v1 dense polar profile, quintic batched per-offset convolution, BF16 channels-last conv training, direction-blend constraint geometry) with residual-cooled generator chart step and bias-corrected per-row drift-SNR prior condensation.
training_details.learning_rates: Strictly constant schedule (`lr_floor=1.0`, `network_lr_floor=1.0`): base LR 0.012, critic multiplier 1.5, pullback weight 1.5, iso weight 0.62, Laguerre rate 0.015, and coherent row rate 0.06.
training_details.gradient_clipping: None. Critic gradients are bounded smoothly by the EMPF Elastic Born-Infeld potential.
training_details.critic_penalty: EMPF prototype-chord Elastic Born-Infeld regularizer (kappa=1.0, ebi_beta=6.0) with settling zero-mean logit gauge and no EMA critic copy.
training_details.damping_and_guards: State-driven generator chart settling g_scale(res_ema), Robbins-Monro hit-cooled prototype centroids, and shock-reactive quantizer re-heating with zero step counters and zero extra RNG draws.
training_details.noise: Zero scheduled critic-input or generator-output additive training noise; task-declared MoG sigma_z is preserved.
training_details.averaging: EMA decay=0 and serve_average=0; all evaluations score live weights.

configuration_notes: All Zador-Gersho quantizer tensors (proto_c, proto_var, proto_w, proto_hits), Kantorovich potentials (psi, w_fake_ema), and per-row moments (row_m, row_v, row_n) serialize in GANTrainer checkpoints under prior_regularizer with strict fail-closed validation.
Standalone component hosts (AE/VAE/DDGAN/BiGAN) calling prior_regularizer(rows) delegate cleanly to EMPFPriorRegularizer under the exact same global t1_prior recipe.
Setting t1_pullback_weight=0.0 disables the pullback step and reproduces exact baseline EMPF trajectories.

equations.label: Gersho Law of Total Variance Decomposition
equations.latex: \operatorname{Cov}(Y) = \operatorname{Cov}_{k \sim w}(C_k) + \sum_{k=1}^K w_k \operatorname{Cov}(Y \mid Y \in V_k), \quad E_k = w_k^{\frac{d}{d+2}} \sigma_{\mathrm{cell},k}^2
equations.explanation: Decomposes arbitrary multi-modal or multi-scale target covariance into macroscopic quantizer centroid spread plus local within-cell pushforward variance across all K/M regimes.

equations.label: Kantorovich-Laguerre Mass-Balanced Island Condensation
equations.latex: k^\star(i) = \arg\min_{1 \le k \le K} \left(\lVert G(\mu_i) - C_k \rVert_2^2 - \psi_k\right), \quad \psi_k \leftarrow \psi_k + \eta_\psi (w_k - \hat w_{\mathrm{fake},k})
equations.explanation: Assigns latent components to discrete Laguerre islands with exact asymptotic probability shares w_k without cross-valley entropic midpoint blur.
